name: Cutting Your Hair
overview: Scripture addresses the practice of cutting hair with specific commands and symbolic actions that reflect obedience and consecration to the Lord. Leviticus instructs believers not to round the corners of their heads or mar their beards, emphasizing holiness in appearance, while Ezekiel directs priests to maintain a balanced grooming standard by neither shaving completely nor letting hair grow too long. Jeremiah uses the cutting off of hair as a sign of lamentation and divine judgment, illustrating its cultural and spiritual significance. Additionally, Leviticus forbids making cuttings in the flesh or marking the body, underscoring the sanctity of the body as belonging to God.
